newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gentyre, MacPhail leap on buy news.
newsitem.headline: Gentyre, MacPhail leap on buy news.

text.p: Shares in South African firms Gentyre Industries Ltd and MacPhail Holdings Ltd jumped on news that Forward Corp Ltd is to buy all their shares in their respective subsidiaries.

Tyremaker Gentyre, which conducts business only through its subsidiaries, would receive just over 52 million fully paid ordinary shares in Forward as well as cash of 158.148 million rand. MacPhail is to receive 14.33 million rand.
Both firms are to distribute the cash windfall to their shareholders. "This is good news for shareholders who really stand to benefit," said one dealer.
By 0811 GMT Gentyre "A" shares had risen 80 cents to 17.50 rand, while the "B" shares put on 200 cents to 17.50 rand. MacPhail stock jumped four cents to 55 cents.
Forward shares rose 10 cents to 280 cents.
Following the acquisitions, Gentyre and McPhail will undergo reductions of capital, will be delisted and will be wound up, liquidated or deregistered.
